mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 600K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 600K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signal a tightening labor market, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 signals decreased economic output, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: positive GDP growth (GDPC1) drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between rising CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals inflationary pressure, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment (UNRATE) above 10% signals labor market distress, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery, rising retail sales (RSAFS) above $380B signal increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window in post-shock recovery regimes.
